notes.text: Students should contact the director of undergraduate studies to design and approve an acceptable course of study before declaring the major.
MAR 487 and MAR 488 may count for a maximum of three credits toward the major.

Marine Sciences Honors Program: students with a 3.50 GPA in all courses for the major by the end of the junior year may apply to the SoMAS undergraduate director. Honors requires an honors thesis written as a scientific journal paper, an oral examination in May, a recommendation from the undergraduate research committee, and a GPA of 3.5 in major courses through senior year. Not evaluated here.
BS/MS program in Marine Sciences/MS in Marine and Atmospheric Sciences: effective Spring 2026, admission is temporarily suspended. Not evaluated here.
